813 people rated this 4.6 stars. And most tourists walk right past it.

Vinwonders Fountain in Phu Quoc is one of those spots that hits differently at night. Water synced to music, lights cycling through the whole show, crowds way thinner than the main park gates.

No price barrier to just stop and watch. Add it to your VinWonders visit and budget an extra 20-30 minutes.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
